title: Battle of Grand Port
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Grand Port", at revision 1379557094, opens: "The Battle of Grand Port was fought on 20–27 August 1810 in the harbour of Grand Port between the British and French navies over the harbour of Grand Port as part of the Mauritius campaign of 1809–1811. A British squadron of four frigates under Captain Samuel Pym sought to blockade Grand Port in the French colony of Isle de France by capturing the fortified Île de la Passe at the port's entrance. The position was seized by a British landing party on 13 August, and when a French squadron under Frigate Captain Guy-Victor Duperré approached the bay nine days later, Pym decided to lure them into coastal waters where his forces could ambush them." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q267339, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1810 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
